ai_summary: This document is a routine regulatory filing by Alpa Laboratories Ltd. confirming compliance with SEBI Regulation 74(5) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company's Registrar and Share Transfer Agent, Bigshare Services Private Limited, certifies the timely and proper processing of physical shares for dematerialization, including acceptance/rejection, listing, mutilation, cancellation, and updating the register of members within the stipulated 15 days. This report indicates sound adherence to share transfer procedures with no material impacts or red flags identified.
